{{Quote|Politorates: the last to know what's going on, and the first to get ejected out the airlock &hellip;|Pentastar Alignment Admiral|<ref name="PA" />}}
'''Politorate''' was an organization with the [[Pentastar Alignment]]'s [[Order]] branch that was tasked with ensuring the preservation and principles of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Politorate assigned [[Politorate officer]]s&mdash;known as "Pols"&mdash;to every office, [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and garrison within the Alignment.
